handback.summary: Added an opt-in auto approve setting: Dokima notes, approves and merges its own reviewed, green pull requests.

criteria.934.1: `dokima/agent_roles.py` next: a passed gate with `merge.auto_approve` on merges via `automerge`, as autopilot does; prints `merged`.
criteria.934.2: `approval_note` in `dokima/agent_autopilot.py` posts one line linking the record's run and naming main's green checks.
criteria.934.3: A blocking review never reaches the merge gate, so nothing is noted or merged.
criteria.934.4: The note and merge happen only when `merge_gate` passed on the tested, up-to-date head.
criteria.934.5: `dokima/defaults.yaml` adds `merge.auto_approve: false`; off, the gate still stops for the owner.
criteria.934.6: Unchanged: the `integrity` lock in `dokima/settings.py` still refuses owner approval.
criteria.934.7: `merge.auto_approve` is a known default, so a repo's true reads with no warning.
criteria.934.8: `bot_review` in `dokima/audit.py` adds one drift line when main needs a review the app cannot bypass.
criteria.934.9: `python3 -m dokima.setup auto-approve REPO` adds the app to main's review bypass, then saves the setting.

raises.label: Merge line says autopilot
raises.text: With auto approve on, the issue line still says Autopilot merged the pull request, though autopilot is off.
